GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1len went back 2nd last 7len 1200m last 8len 600m Hard Ridden last Straightened Up 10th Hooked Out Straight made no ground # back/no run on

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Approaching the hampered and had to be steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back near last 7-8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on well but never thretening # even effort
Slow Out 2 Lengths , Settled back last rails off tardy start 12 Lengths 800m, never close # always out back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 600m, shifted in and made contact with the running rail and as a consequence, became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, ran on well making good ground late # best work late

Slow away. No early speed & raced out of picture early . Stayed out of picture midrace & chasing on inside (12L from lead) on home turn. No real improvement in straight. Vetted clear. # Not competitive.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride and shortly after was severely crowded. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Hampered & nearly lost rider @ 1200m. Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & chasing 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along 3 Wide (8L from lead). Eased down in straight. Vetted - cardiac arrhythmia # cardiac arrhythmia
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Near the 1200m clipped heels, resulting in its rider nearly becoming dislodged. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be displaying cardiac arrhythmia for the first time. Satisfactory ECG and vet report immediately after gallop since recived

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and crowded a runner. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.
